page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.12xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with dedicated Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, delivering 48 virtual CPUs. The instance pairs this compute capacity with 192.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It operates without dedicated GPUs or hardware accelerators.

Storage and network characteristics reflect a decoupled architecture. The ecs.g8i.12xlarge instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring attached network or cloud block storage for persistent file systems. For inter-system communication and external data transit, it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. Public IPv4 addresses are not included complimentary.

Because the server maintains a balanced ratio of 48 dedicated vCPUs to 192.0 GB of memory without specialized acceleration hardware, it offers consistent compute density. Tradeoffs include the dependency on external network storage for all I/O needs. The instance is suited for enterprise applications requiring high core counts and symmetric resource allocation, such as distributed databases, backend web serving, enterprise resource planning, and intermediate data processing pipelines.
